operation_proposals.source_operation: Rasterize genomic sequence into annotated RGB DNA-document pages
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no operation representing glyph rendering, pixel-canvas construction, case conversion, page continuation, or simultaneous nucleotide-to-bounding-box annotation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: SAM-Conv-CLIP-L visual front-end with fixed convolutional downsampling
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The documented step is learned visual feature extraction with a fixed convolutional downsampling schedule; no catalog primitive represents this vision-encoder boundary.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Mean reduction over the page dimension after multi-page self-attention
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no reduction or pooling operation whose declared semantics represent averaging across the page axis.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Structured multimodal conversation assembly and teacher-forced decoder receipt
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The documented input combines role fields, textual content, an image placeholder, ordered images, a NUM IMAGES meta line, fused visual tokens, and shifted assistant-response tokens; no existing operation represents this complete multimodal message boundary.

operation_proposals.source_operation: Enumerate all occurrences of a sampled nucleotide query across rendered lines and convert matches to spatial boxes
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog represents sampling, selection, partitioning, and alignment separately, but has no primitive for symbolic subsequence matching followed by spatial match enumeration.
